WITH RECURSIVE target AS (
  SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols
  WHERE file_id = 'auto_ontology/server/models.py' AND name = 'ApiModel'
),
direct AS (
  SELECT cb.class_symbol_id
  FROM code.class_bases cb, target t
  WHERE cb.base_symbol_id = t.symbol_id
     OR (cb.base_symbol_id IS NULL AND cb.base_name = 'ApiModel')
     OR (cb.base_symbol_id IS NULL AND cb.base_name = '_Payload')
     OR (cb.base_symbol_id IS NULL AND regexp_extract(cb.base_name, '^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)', 1) = 'ApiModel')
     OR (cb.base_symbol_id IS NULL AND regexp_extract(cb.base_name, '^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)', 1) = '_Payload')
),
chain AS (
  SELECT class_symbol_id, 1 AS depth FROM direct
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cb.class_symbol_id, ch.depth + 1
  FROM code.class_bases cb
  JOIN chain ch ON cb.base_symbol_id = ch.class_symbol_id
  WHERE cb.class_symbol_id <> ch.class_symbol_id
),
best AS (
  SELECT class_symbol_id, MIN(depth) AS depth
  FROM chain GROUP BY class_symbol_id
)
SELECT b.class_symbol_id, b.depth
FROM best b
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM direct d WHERE d.class_symbol_id = b.class_symbol_id
)
ORDER BY b.class_symbol_id

request:
Which classes inherit from ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/models.py) only indirectly, i.e. through at least one intermediate class of this repository, and do not name ApiModel directly in their class statement? An import alias of ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/responses.py imports it as _Payload) counts as naming ApiModel directly, and a subscripted base such as ListResponse[T] counts as its class. For each, give the class symbol ID and the length of the shortest inheritance chain to ApiModel (2 when the parent class directly subclasses ApiModel).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), depth (integer).
explanation: Finds ApiModel in models.py, then computes direct subclasses (including the _Payload alias and subscripted bases) and recursively derives inheritance depths for all descending classes. It keeps the minimum depth per class and excludes classes that directly name ApiModel, leaving only indirect subclasses with their shortest chain length to ApiModel.
